name: limit_only
comment: Limit without offset: a single bound limit parameter. Where the paging clause needs ORDER BY (SQL Server's OFFSET/FETCH), an unordered page gains the constant placeholder ordering (ADR-0024) - the page was order-arbitrary anyway.

sqlite.sql: select id, role_name, created_at, updated_at from roles limit @c0

sqlserver.sql: select [id], [role_name], [created_at], [updated_at] from [roles] order by (select null) offset 0 rows fetch next @c0 rows only
